relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: play a critical role in the pathogenesis and progression of various inflammatory diseases through regulating the release and activation of inflammatory cytokines and inducing cell prytosis

key_findings: Review linking NLRP3 inflammasome to osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and other bone and joint diseases.
Small-molecule NLRP3 antagonists show therapeutic potential but need further clinical exploration.
